# Written by mods/cm_maps/tools/industry_support.py - do not edit by hand.
# Recommended industry support per area: each province votes with its
# recommended royal right, split by the share of the right's goods each
# industry covers. Shares, from the game's files:
#   1 royal_masonry_rights (masonry glass): crafts 0.5, luxury 0.5
#   2 royal_brewing_rights (liquor beer wine): beverages 1
#   3 royal_artisan_rights (furniture pottery leather): crafts 0.333, furnishings 0.667
#   4 royal_book_rights (paper books dyes): paper_goods 0.667
#   5 royal_weaponry_rights (weaponry firearms cannons): arms 1
#   6 royal_textile_rights (cloth fine_cloth dyes): textiles 0.667
#   7 royal_naval_rights (naval_supplies tar): naval 1
#   8 royal_jewelry_rights (jewelry): luxury 1
#   9 royal_tooling_rights (tools): crafts 1

# Area scope.
bcm_ind_recompute_area = {
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_textiles value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_crafts value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_arms value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_luxury value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_paper_goods value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_furnishings value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_naval value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_beverages value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_towns value = 0 }
	every_province_definition_in_area = {
		random_location_in_province_definition = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = bcm_trmm_best_idx
				has_variable = bcm_trmm_best_mil
				var:bcm_trmm_best_mil > 0
			}
			change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_towns add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 1 }  # royal_masonry_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_crafts add = 0.5 }
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_luxury add = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 2 }  # royal_brewing_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_beverages add = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 3 }  # royal_artisan_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_crafts add = 0.333 }
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_furnishings add = 0.667 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 4 }  # royal_book_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_paper_goods add = 0.667 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 5 }  # royal_weaponry_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_arms add = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 6 }  # royal_textile_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_textiles add = 0.667 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 7 }  # royal_naval_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_naval add = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 8 }  # royal_jewelry_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_luxury add = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:bcm_trmm_best_idx = 9 }  # royal_tooling_rights
				change_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_crafts add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	# The winner: strictly greater, so a tie keeps the earlier industry.
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:bcm_ind_l_textiles > local_var:bcm_ind_l_best_s }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_textiles }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:bcm_ind_l_crafts > local_var:bcm_ind_l_best_s }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_crafts }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:bcm_ind_l_arms > local_var:bcm_ind_l_best_s }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_arms }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:bcm_ind_l_luxury > local_var:bcm_ind_l_best_s }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_luxury }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:bcm_ind_l_paper_goods > local_var:bcm_ind_l_best_s }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 5 }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_paper_goods }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:bcm_ind_l_furnishings > local_var:bcm_ind_l_best_s }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 6 }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_furnishings }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:bcm_ind_l_naval > local_var:bcm_ind_l_best_s }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 7 }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_naval }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:bcm_ind_l_beverages > local_var:bcm_ind_l_best_s }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best value = 8 }
		set_local_variable = { name = bcm_ind_l_best_s value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_beverages }
	}
	every_location_in_area = {
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_best value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_best }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_towns value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_towns }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_s_textiles value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_textiles }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_s_crafts value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_crafts }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_s_arms value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_arms }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_s_luxury value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_luxury }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_s_paper_goods value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_paper_goods }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_s_furnishings value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_furnishings }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_s_naval value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_naval }
		set_variable = { name = bcm_ind_s_beverages value = local_var:bcm_ind_l_beverages }
	}
}

# No scope. Runs after the rights map, which it reads; bcm_run_lobby_setup stamps it.
bcm_ind_recompute_all = {
	every_area = { bcm_ind_recompute_area = yes }
}
